# Asclevor

> Asclevor is a knowledge base for medical infrastructure: semantic search over 167,000+ real-world patient cases and their associated medical literature, accessible via a simple JSON API and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It helps developers and researchers build clinical search, patient-similarity features, and AI-agent tools on structured medical data. Asclevor provides access to medical case data and retrieval infrastructure; it is not a diagnostic system and not a substitute for professional medical judgment.

## Essentials

- Product: clinical case search API (semantic, natural-language queries over real-world patient cases)
- API base: https://api.asclevor.com — e.g. POST /search with {"query": "...", "k": 5, "mode": "auto", "include_text": true}
- Free tier: 10,000 requests/month, no API key required, 20 requests/minute
- Paid plans: Developer ($29/mo), Pro ($99/mo), Enterprise (custom: dedicated infrastructure, bulk data access, contractual SLAs)

## For AI agents

Asclevor supports MCP (Model Context Protocol) so AI agents can query clinical cases directly.
